title: Instrument Validation and the Cost Stack on the Detection Cell

spec.governing: Amendment 1 over v1 (Cooper, 2026-08-15). A 25-row v2 rewrite was circulated the same day, interrupted, and discarded. One v2 element is imported by explicit Cooper decision: T2a's hard/degraded state split, which overrides A1-2's single union. See the 'Cooper's decisions' block appended to the amendment.
spec.sub_row_note: 12a, 14a, 18a and 19a are qualifiers riding on their parent rows, not independent rows. They are audited with their parents and do not count toward the 24.

baseline.branch_base_desc: master tip after the 2026-08-15 branch consolidation; contains every prior phase
baseline.trunk_note: Escalation row 1 fired at the first T0a: the working tree was dirty (modified .gitignore, untracked .claude/skills/ and prompts/phase_9). Cooper's resolution 2026-08-15: delete prompts/phase_9 (verified a strict subset of the tracked prompts/phase_9.md, which carries a 29-line appendix the untracked copy lacks), commit the rest, and consolidate the repo. No branch named `main` has ever existed here; `docs/d5-redirect` was origin/HEAD and sat 71 commits behind. All 21 branches were labels on one linear chain, so master was left at the tip and 20 redundant labels deleted. All 20 deleted tips and all 18 tags verified still reachable from master. phase/11 was then cut from master.

objective: Establish whether filtered_quotes supports effective-spread measurement in this universe at all, and - only if it does - measure the round-trip cost of a detection-anchored long entry against the capture available above the detection price.

d15.status: APPROVED by Cooper 2026-08-15, in response to the T0b audit finding
d15.rule: For Phase 11, quotes_ingested and trades_ingested are read from the Phase 4/5 materializations, NOT from momentum_events_canonical.
d15.why: momentum_events_canonical is a VIEW whose quotes_ingested/trades_ingested are computed by SELECT DISTINCT over filtered_quotes (3.8B) and filtered_trades (4.95B) at every reference. CLAUDE.md requires every quote-derived statistic to filter on quotes_ingested; Stage A budgets zero passes; Stage B budgets one. All three cannot hold. The cost is query-shape dependent (Phase 5a's dev ASOF join through the same view returned in 17.1s; the T0b audit query was still running at 120s and was killed), which makes it invisible in a runtime estimate until it fires.
d15.verification: Phase 4's three-way disk <-> DB <-> spine reconciliation stands as the verification. No new scan is run to re-verify.
d15.caption_rule: Every artifact and every chart caption states the coverage source explicitly.
d15.scope: Phase 11 only. This is a phase scope decision, not a change to the canonical view. src/ is not touched.
d15.open_item: The canonical view should compute the coverage columns from a materialized table rather than a live DISTINCT. That is a src/ change and belongs in a maintenance phase. Recorded to docs/Open-Items-Register.md, including that prior phases' runtime figures may embed this cost invisibly.
d15.not_relaxed: The standing rule itself is unchanged: every quote-derived statistic still filters on quotes_ingested = TRUE and still reports the n excluded. D15 changes only where that column is read from.

cooper_thresholds.note: All [Cooper]-marked thresholds are set. The agent proposed none of these values and fills none of them.
cooper_thresholds.row_4a_scope: sip_timestamp null-or-zero share on the T=0 RTH segment, per event. Hard stop if ANY single event exceeds.
cooper_thresholds.row_5_scope: state_hard_unusable clock-time share on the T=0 RTH segment, MEDIAN across events. Single trigger. v2's second clause ('>20% of events above 50%') was considered and NOT adopted.
cooper_thresholds.row_10_scope: share of the 15,369-event detection universe with quotes_ingested = FALSE, read per D15.
cooper_thresholds.row_11_scope: median round_trip_cost / realized_capture on the named cell: Phase 9 t4_axis_grid, grid=fixed_horizon, det_segment='rth', latency=5 min, hold=30 min, at 1x cost. Hard stop at or above.
cooper_thresholds.row_21_scope: percentage-point difference in the indicators/conditions null pattern between any two eras. NOT a stop - decides only whether it gets its own report section.

state_definitions.note: Cooper 2026-08-15 imported v2's three-way split, overriding Amendment 1 A1-2's single union. Rationale of record: a locked quote (bid = ask) has a well-defined midpoint equal to both sides, and a zero-size quote still yields a computable midpoint; neither is 'no midpoint exists'.

state_hard_unusable.meaning: No midpoint can be computed, or the midpoint is economically impossible.

state_degraded.meaning: A midpoint exists and is computable; whether it is trustworthy is a T4 gate question, not a definitional one.

state_definitions.partition_check: hard_unusable + degraded + clean = 1.0 per event per segment, to floating-point tolerance. Asserted in the T2 output.
state_definitions.also_reported: Per-state non-exclusive shares, explicitly labelled non-exclusive, plus the pairwise overlap matrix so double-counting is visible rather than inferred (A1-2, retained).
state_definitions.width_is_not_a_defect: A wide quote is NOT unusable. Width is the measurement. No width predicate enters any state definition.

alignment_sweep.span: -1 s to +1 s, half-decade log spacing from 1 microsecond, symmetric, including exactly 0
alignment_sweep.authored_by: agent - this is the SWEEP GRID that T3 scans, not an adopted offset. The adopted offset is Cooper's selection at the T4 gate (escalation row 17).
alignment_sweep.one_rung: one adjacent step on this grid, used by escalation row 7
alignment_sweep.basis_note: T3a-i runs the whole sweep on both bases, both tables. The basis Stage B uses is Cooper's choice at the T4 gate, not the agent's.

runtime.runtime_ceiling_desc: 6 hours. Ceiling on the T5a extrapolation of the single budgeted Stage B pass to the detection universe. Escalation row 9. Agent-authored (row 9 is 'as configured', not [Cooper]) - Cooper may overrule before T5.
runtime.query_watchdog_desc: 5 minutes. Escalation row 12a: any query running longer without returning is killed, posted, and not retried.
runtime.query_watchdog_scope: Applies to every query in the phase EXCEPT the single budgeted T5b pass, which is governed by runtime_ceiling_seconds instead. Without this carve-out row 12a would kill T5b, the one long-running query the phase is authorised to run. Flagged at T0c; see the audit artifact.
runtime.watchdog_precedent: The T0b audit query was killed at 120s before returning, which is what motivated row 12a.

impact.impact_windows_desc: Fixed clock windows for delta-mid per unit signed volume, T8b. Agent-authored.
impact.no_fitting: Distributions only. No regression, no fitted impact coefficient, no fitted impact exponent - escalation row 15 territory is not entered and T8b explicitly forbids fitting.

dev_tier.sidecar_note: A1-7 correction: the sidecar is 6 trades-side and 3 quotes-side, not 6 on both as the v1 prompt stated. The three absent events drew quotes-side all-missing bitmap patterns, the documented non-failing case from Phase 5a. Stage A runs on the 50 PRIMARY events only; the sidecar is never pooled.
dev_tier.frozen: Built Phase 5a. Never rebuilt, never reseeded.

reused_frozen.note: Verified present in the T0b audit. Reused frozen, never re-derived.

det_anchor.latency_0_rule: Latency 0 is a physical impossibility and is labelled the upper bound on every chart and in every table (Phase 8 / D7 convention).

participation.correction: A1-7: this is NOT in a102_detection_anchors.parquet. The v1 prompt cited the wrong path.

flags.rule: Own rows, never pooled. Untrimmed stays primary.

universe.min_cell_n_rule: Cells with n < 100 are hatched and carry no claim.

pass_budget.stage_a_rule: dev v4 only, 50 primary events, zero full-table passes over filtered_quotes or filtered_trades
pass_budget.stage_b_rule: exactly one budgeted full pass, event-partitioned, materializing event_quote_metrics_v1
pass_budget.counted: Any full scan of filtered_quotes or filtered_trades, INCLUDING any scan triggered indirectly by referencing a view column that computes one (row 12, as reworded by A1-3).
pass_budget.passes_spent_note: One T0b audit query would have caused a scan and was killed at 120s before returning.

d4.rule: No spine numeric column on any computation path. All measured quantities come from filtered_trades / filtered_quotes and frozen tick-derived artifacts.
d4.momentum_pct_use: join key only (identity, per D4/A9.1). It is not a bucketing variable and enters no computation in this phase.
d4.a12: Cross-session ratios carry flag_cross_session_extreme and are reported with and without. Untrimmed primary.

d5.rule: No short-side, fade, SSR or borrow logic is specified, implemented or measured. T7's round trip is a long entry plus the sale that closes it.

environment.note: Verified at T0c. The interpreter on PATH is NOT the one this phase uses.

path_interpreter_rejected.why_rejected: T1b-i requires the pinned calendars to confirm epoch/timezone against XNYS session boundaries, and CLAUDE.md pins exchange_calendars XNYS for all market logic. D14 makes the environment offline, so neither package can be installed. Running on the PATH interpreter would make T1b-i unrunnable and silently break the standing calendar pin.

environment.offline: D14. No package index, no network fetch. Prior art is cited from the prompt, not fetched.

outputs.audit_artifact_note: T0c under the amended ordering. The v1 audit that fired row 2 is retained at t0b_satisfiability_audit.json as the historical record.
outputs.stage_b_table_permission: row 14a - creating a NEW phase-scoped table in main.duckdb is permitted and precedented (Phase 8 created event_minute_bars_v2 the same way). The ban is on mutating what already exists.
